question: In the CO2-WAG enhanced oil recovery study with stacking-learning proxy models, how many injection and production wells does the reservoir sector have, and how much remaining oil does it hold?
expect: 19 injection wells, 10 production wells, 3.5 billion barrels of remaining oil (sec. 2)
rendered: The reservoir sector in the CO2-WAG-EOR process has 19 injection wells and 10 oil production wells. It contains 3.5 billion barrels of remaining oil after the primary and secondary production stages.
